select citation.message_id, citation.citation_index,
chunk.id as chunk_id, document.id as document_id,
document.title, document.category, document.source_department, document.source_url, document.published_at
from ai_message_citations citation
inner join ai_messages message on message.id = citation.message_id
inner join knowledge_chunks chunk on chunk.id = citation.chunk_id
inner join knowledge_documents document on document.id = chunk.document_id
where message.conversation_id = #{conversationId}
order by message.id asc, citation.citation_index asc
